scriptComments: Look at how many brodcasts this game has! Seriously, it's insane... I have no life...
If you want to save your character you can right click on the blue menu and click "save picture of stage"

Hello! This is AnaniAnime. If you want to make your own game you can look through this to see how it's done. You can remix this as long as you give credit :)Please don't copy the game though because I've seen someone do that before and also please don't use any of the sprites.Thank you very much for playing! ♥
